mapping.title: What {{brand}} recognised in your file

mapping.unattachedList: These columns will go nowhere: {{list}}. Attach them if they matter.
mapping.missingRequired: Required field with no column: {{list}}. The import stays blocked until it is attached.

stopped.failed: The import stopped at row {{line}} of {{total}}. {{created}} created and {{updated}} updated ARE in your base — nothing was lost. Drop the same file again and rerun: I'll pick up exactly where it stopped.
stopped.unknown: The import stopped at row {{line}} of {{total}}. {{created}} created and {{updated}} updated ARE in your base. Row {{line}} left without an answer: I don't know whether it was written, and I won't guess. Resume the import to tell me what to do with it.

resume.title: Pick up where it stopped
resume.stoppedAt: {{done}} of {{total}} rows were written — {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated. They are in your base.
resume.stoppedUnknown: This import stopped and I don't know how many rows were written. That is not « none »: don't rerun it from the start, you would create duplicates.
resume.whyFailed: The connection never went through: the next row almost certainly never landed, so it will be replayed.
resume.whyUnknown: The request left without an answer coming back. I don't know whether that row was written.
resume.dropSameFile: Drop EXACTLY the same file again, then rerun the simulation. I check it really is the same one before skipping a single row — resuming at the same number in a different file would skip that many, silently.
resume.uncertainQuestion: Row {{line}} left without an answer. What do you want me to do with it?
resume.rewriteRisk: If it had already been written, you get a duplicate on that row — exactly one, and you know which.
resume.skipRisk: If it had not been written, that row will be missing — exactly one, and you know which.
resume.mustChoose: Pick one: I won't decide for you on a row whose fate I don't know.
